chars.MOHSIN: MOHSIN: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hooded parka over a black t-shirt, dark blue slim jeans and white sneakers.
chars.WALID: WALID: a young man wearing a maroon crew-neck sweater, grey jogger sweatpants and black slippers.
chars.AMINE: AMINE: a young man wearing a green-and-white striped football jersey, black track pants and grey socks.
chars.KENZA: KENZA: a young woman with a long dark ponytail wearing a fitted cream blazer over a black top, black office trousers and a small red handbag.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small shared student apartment in France. WALID sits on a sofa in the dim light of a lamp, surprised, holding a ringing smartphone to his ear, worried expression. A dark window with city lights behind.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, a French city street with wet pavement under orange streetlights. MOHSIN walks fast with his hood up, phone at his ear, sad and tense face, hands shaking.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside the apartment living room at night. MOHSIN sits on the sofa with his head down and hands clasped, ashamed. WALID and AMINE sit facing him on chairs, leaning forward, listening with concern. Mugs of tea on a low table.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, a modern open-plan office in France with glass walls. KENZA smiles proudly at her new desk with a laptop, first day at a new job, colleagues' empty desks around.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Late evening, the apartment kitchen. MOHSIN sits alone at a small table with two plates of cold dinner, looking at the wall clock with a worried face, phone in hand.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Evening outside an office building in a French city. KENZA walks away from the building toward the street, looking back over her shoulder, smiling, holding her red handbag, warm lights of a café-bar across the street.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, a bedroom. MOHSIN lies awake in bed staring at the ceiling, his phone glowing on the pillow next to him, an empty side of the bed, sad and lonely.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, a street in a French city. MOHSIN stands half hidden behind a street corner, peeking with suspicious wide eyes toward a glowing bar entrance across the street (no readable sign).
